verdict.rationale: Docs strongly support creating and iteratively editing documents, presentations, spreadsheets, and PDFs, with review/annotation and export/download workflows (chatgpt-docs-8, chatgpt-docs-30, chatgpt-docs-60, chatgpt-docs-66, chatgpt-docs-68, chatgpt-docs-70), plus a dedicated artifacts/canvas viewer supporting annotations and comments for iterative refinement (chatgpt-docs-7, chatgpt-docs-18, chatgpt-docs-24, chatgpt-docs-101). Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration specifically of document/presentation export workflows (community evidence pack focuses on other capabilities like coding/search, not file export).
